captainGuideIntro: As captain, you help make sure nobody is overlooked. Write your own weekly opening message and check plans and buddy contacts.
captainGuideDetails: The captain overview shows who still needs a plan and which buddy contacts are overdue. Gently remind the member or the person looking out for them; you do not need to do their activities or contact everyone yourself. Set the tone with a weekly opening message and suggest a shared activity. At the end of the week, recognize the group’s effort. Being captain does not grant access to private result details.
